name: Make Me Shine Again My Lovegirl
source:
You wake up with no memories of who you are, in a place supposedly called your home. Something is off about this place, so you try to escape to the outside world. Luckily your wife, Victoria, is there with you... right?

[From [url=https://mechymachina.itch.io/make-me-shine-again-my-lovegirl-act1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来时不记得自己是谁，在一个据称称为你的家的地方。这个地方有些不对劲，所以你试图逃到外面的世界。幸运的是，你的妻子维多利亚在你身边……对吗？

[来自[url=https://mechymachina.itch.io/make-me-shine-again-my-lovegirl-act1]itch.io[/url]]
